name: iCode STEM Universe
detailed_description:
Embark on an Educational Journey with Our Immersive VR Learning Experience!


Welcome to a groundbreaking virtual reality experience that brings the wonders of the cosmos, the intricacies of engineering, and the mysteries of our planet to life like never before. With a fusion of cutting-edge technology and captivating content, our VR experience offers an unparalleled opportunity to learn, explore, and engage with 30 lessons in three dynamic fields: Astronomy & Space Travel, Mechanical & Electrical Engineering, and Geology & Earth Science.

🚀 Astronomy & Space Travel:

Unleash your inner astronaut as you venture into the cosmos. Discover the planets, stars, galaxies, and phenomena that make up our universe. Navigate through the solar system, witness cosmic events, and even journey to the Moon and beyond. Get a taste of life in zero gravity and unravel the secrets of space travel.

🔧 Electrical & Mechanical Engineering:

Dive into the world of innovation and mechanics. Understand the principles of engineering as you tinker with intricate machines, delve into electrical circuits, and explore the mechanics of everyday objects. Build, simulate, and interact with devices, all within a captivating VR environment that brings engineering concepts to life.

🌍 Geology & Earth Science:

Embark on a virtual voyage to the heart of our planet. Witness the Earth's geological wonders, from the fiery depths of volcanoes to the sculpting forces of erosion. Unearth the secrets of rocks, minerals, and fossils, and participate in interactive simulations that allow you to experience landscapes and understand Earth's dynamic processes.

Key Features:

  • 🌌 Engaging VR Environments: Immerse yourself in stunning and interactive virtual landscapes tailored to each educational field.
  • 🧑‍🏫 Expert Instruction: Learn from expert instructors who guide you through lessons, experiments, and challenges.
  • 🤖 Hands-On Activities: Engage in hands-on activities that reinforce your understanding and let you experiment with real-world scenarios.
  • 🌟 Interactive Simulations: Simulate space missions, control engineering systems, and witness geological transformations firsthand.
  • 🎓 Suitable for All Ages: Whether you're a student, an aspiring scientist, or just curious about the world around you, our VR experience offers something for everyone.

Ignite your curiosity and expand your horizons with an educational adventure that transcends traditional learning. Explore the cosmos, tinker with technology, and unravel Earth's geological history—all in the immersive world of virtual reality. Get ready to embark on an educational journey that's out of this world. Start your VR learning experience today!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 1060 or AMD Radeon HD 6000 series graphics card
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 256 GB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2070
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 256 GB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR
